name: Cleanse
summary: A small window with a row for each member of your group, or your raid. A row lights up, in the colour of what afflicts them, when that person has something your class can cure: click it to cast your cure, right-click for your second one, Shift-click for your class's area cure. It casts only when you click, never by itself. During a fight the window can't be moved, shown or hidden, because the game protects anything that casts from a click. It needs nothing from the Ryna app, keeps nothing but where you put its window, and sends nothing to Ryna. Nothing in chat.
